messages:
Aisha: Hey runtime — seeing a subtle tail-latency bump in canary for model-xyz with batch=1 and seq=1024. Can someone run a quick, compact nsys + torch.profiler capture (30s+) and produce a kernel timeline + flamegraph? I have a driver script and sample prompt ready.

Tom: I can spin this up. Which image/tag and commit should I use? Also which host (RTX/MI)?

Aisha: Use image r-inference:canary-2026-03-16 (sha d5c4). Prefer RTX-6000 host for parity with the canary run. I'll attach the input driver and seeds in a sec.

Ravi: Quick capture recipe that has worked for short reproductions:
```bash
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --capture-range c --output /tmp/engrt_trace --sample=none \
  --force-overwrite --stop-on-exit --compress on --duration 35s \n# run the python driver under the nsys wrapper
```
For the torch.profiler side, instrument with schedule=(1,2,5), record_shapes=True, profile_memory=True and save to /tmp/torchprof.pth

Tom: Good. I'll also run a small warmup sequence (4 inits with max_seq=128) before the capture to exercise the KV path and avoid cold-start noise.

Becky: When you upload traces, please run the redact helper: `perf-bot redact /tmp/engrt_trace.nsys --remove-uuids --strip-headers` — we need to scrub keys/IDs. I can generate flamegraphs with speedscope + inferno once the artifacts are up.

Aisha: Important: do not include customer prompts in plain text. Replace with prompt_id tokens. I will provide sanitized driver that maps prompt -> id.

perf-bot: Upload policy check: max artifact size 200MB. Use s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/eng-runtime/2184500000/ as target. Running redaction will produce a .redacted.nsys and index.json.

Tom: On it. Running on rtx6000-03 now. Command I'm using: 
```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --capture-range c --output /tmp/2184500000_trace --duration 40s \
  --compress on python run_driver.py --model model-xyz --seq 1024 --batch 1
```
Also starting torch.profiler in parallel with the schedule above.

Ravi: If you observe a big KV gap, run one sample with `--kv-warmup 4` and then capture. Also snapshot `/proc/driver/nv/links` for kernel symbol mapping. I can map kernels afterwards if you include the nsys .qdrep and the host dhd debug symbols.

Aisha: Uploaded sanitized driver to the thread and shared the creds via 1Password link. I'll post the baseline run id too.

Tom: Upload complete: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/eng-runtime/2184500000/engrt_trace.nsys.gz and /torchprof/torchprof_2184500000.pth. perf-bot reports 93MB after compression.

perf-bot: Artifact received and redaction passed. Public link: https://s3.redwood.internal/redwood-perf/artifacts/eng-runtime/2184500000/ (access: eng-runtime, perf). Index: engrt_trace.index.json

Becky: Quick skim of flamegraph (preliminary): main hotspot is attention_forward_cuda (kernel heavy) and small spike in cublasGemmStridedBatched. I'll produce a full flamegraph and post screenshots.

Aisha: This matches what I saw in prod smoke. If attention_forward is ~2x slower than baseline, we should consider reverting the microkernel change from PR #1289. Can someone run a quick bisect comparing canary vs baseline kernels?

Tom: Starting bisect: I'll run three anchored traces (baseline, canary, patch) and diff with inferno. ETA ~40m. I'll ping here with results and the flamegraphs.

Ravi: Ping me when the bisect artifacts are up; I'll do kernel symbol mapping and a quick per-kernel time breakdown.

Aisha: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep notes in the s3 folder under /notes.txt so PMs can follow.

Tom: Finished initial bisect — attaching short summary in s3/compare.json. Preliminary: attention_forward shows ~1.9x median latency increase on canary vs baseline. Leaving full analysis to @Ravi and @Becky.

perf-bot: Comparative artifacts bundled: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/eng-runtime/2184500000/compare_bundle.tar.gz (size 210MB — archived). If you need smaller exchange, use the trimmed nvtx-only captures.

Becky: Uploaded final flamegraphs + inferno diffs to the folder and added a short writeup `flamegraph_notes.md`. Primary suspect: recent tiling change in attention kernel.

Aisha: We'll hold the rollout pending a follow-up patch. Filing a short rollback ticket. Thanks everyone for the fast capture and analysis :thumbsup:
